bounded_host_request.command:
set -e
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "96d01bb845152569658ccd1187b502bf33649c06"
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
test "$(git stash list | wc -l)" -eq 3
before="$(sha256sum operations/master-internal-repositories.json | awk '{print $1}')"
git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "e657645085b725271095bcf2521d2f13ba45009e"
test -z "$(git diff --name-only HEAD "e657645085b725271095bcf2521d2f13ba45009e" -- operations/master-internal-repositories.json)"
git merge --ff-only "e657645085b725271095bcf2521d2f13ba45009e" >/tmp/gace-reflect-agent-main.log
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "e657645085b725271095bcf2521d2f13ba45009e"
test "$(sha256sum operations/master-internal-repositories.json | awk '{print $1}')" = "$before"
test "$(git stash list | wc -l)" -eq 3
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
echo CHAT_MAIN_REFLECT_FAST_FORWARD_PASS
git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD
printf 'REGISTRY_HASH_PREFIX='; printf '%s\n' "$before" | cut -c1-12
echo STASH_COUNT=3
